projectionName: NSIDC Sea Ice Polar Stereographic North (Hughes 1980)
mapNote: Monthly extent outlines (15% concentration threshold); small polygons under 100 km² omitted for display. Extent values retain the original unsimplified NSIDC CSV values.
normalizationNote: The official 2021 ZIP uses WGS84 EPSG:3413; its coordinates were converted into the common Hughes 1980 EPSG:3411 projection. All other years use Hughes 1980 directly.
